relationships.subject: neutrophil extracellular traps
relationships.evidence_quote: the injection of NETs into joints of naïve animals generated a dose-dependent reduction of mechanical threshold

relationships.subject: neutrophil extracellular traps
relationships.evidence_quote: an increase of articular oedema, inflammatory cytokine production and cyclooxygenase-2 expression

relationships.subject: Pulmozyme
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment of AIA mice with a peptidyl arginine deiminase 4 inhibitor or with PLZ inhibited the joint hyperalgesia.

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: In mice deficient for Tnfr1, Il1r, Tlr4 and Tlr9, joint hyperalgesia induced by NETs was prevented.

key_findings: NETs injected into joints cause hyperalgesia, oedema, cytokine and COX-2 induction; NET degradation or inhibition reduces AIA hyperalgesia.
NET-induced hyperalgesia was prevented in Tnfr1, Il1r, Tlr4 and Tlr9 deficient mice.
